title: Settlement closeout stalls during account rollup
summary: The nightly closeout exits partway through account rollup and leaves the run incomplete.
precursor: A late partner correction was replayed after the same settlement window had already been partially processed.
impact: Finance dashboards remain on the prior close, and the morning payout review is delayed until reconciliation completes.

title: Catalog export misses its delivery window
summary: The scheduled export repeatedly stops while publishing a completed catalog snapshot.
precursor: The downstream merchandising endpoint began taking longer to respond during the regional inventory refresh.
impact: Retail channels continue serving yesterday's assortment and new product changes are not visible before store opening.

title: Warehouse stock snapshot cannot reach its source
summary: The inventory snapshot job aborts before collecting data from the warehouse API.
precursor: The overnight warehouse maintenance window included a service endpoint change shortly before the snapshot schedule fired.
impact: Available-to-promise counts are stale across fulfillment centers, increasing the risk of accepting orders for unavailable stock.

title: Search reindex run cycles on one queued record
summary: The reindex run makes no forward progress and its worker repeatedly restarts the same segment.
precursor: A content migration introduced an uncommon legacy record into the segment picked up by the overnight reindex.
impact: Recent catalog edits remain missing from search results, while the backlog delays the next scheduled index refresh.

title: Compliance digest run ends before delivery
summary: The scheduled digest assembles its report but stops before submitting it to the delivery service.
precursor: The identity provider rotated credentials during the weekend maintenance period, ahead of the weekly report schedule.
impact: Compliance recipients do not receive the expected weekly digest, creating a manual review gap until delivery is restored.
